# harnessed

> Test harnesses for components and pages: like page objects, but for components too. One API
> that runs under every major JavaScript test runner (Testing Library, Playwright, Ember,
> Cypress, WebdriverIO, Vitest browser mode, Puppeteer, TestCafe, Nightwatch, node:test and
> Bun), with Gherkin on top, and inside Storybook's play functions.

A harness is a class that lets a test drive a component the way a person would, through methods
named for what the component does. Its fields are `Query`s declared with decorators
(`@ByRole`, `@ByLabel`, `@ByTestId`), and it is constructed with a driver's env
(`dom(...)`, `pw(page)`, `ember()`, ...), so the same class runs in a jsdom unit test and in
a real browser. A `PageHarness` (`@harnessed-ts/page`) adds a path, `goto()` and a readiness
check. `@harnessed-ts/mock` mocks HTTP and WebSocket APIs the same way under every driver.

Packages are published under the `@harnessed-ts` scope: `core` (queries, selectors,
`ComponentHarness`, decorators, `configure()`), one driver package per runner, `page`,
`mock`, `gherkin`, `storybook`, the `qunit` and `chai` assertion adapters, an
`eslint-plugin`, and `claude` (an authoring skill and its install CLI).

## API

- [API reference](https://joegaudet.com/harnessed/api/): every export of every package, from
  the latest release
- [llms-full.txt](https://joegaudet.com/harnessed/api/llms-full.txt): this file followed by the
  whole API reference as Markdown
- [api.json](https://joegaudet.com/harnessed/api/api.json): the API reference as TypeDoc's JSON
  model, for tools
